messages:
Maya Chen: FYI — notes from a call with Kestrel Retail. Two recurring asks: 1) customer-visible model drift when we roll model variants (they want stronger "endpoint-level pinning"); 2) onboarding scripts intermittently hit rate-limit errors on Dedicated during heavy eval runs. Renewal conversation in ~3w, they flagged these as renewal risks.
Eliot Ramirez: can you drop the exact error / sample request? :eyes:
Maya Chen: copying the excerpt we captured — small logs and a sample request they used.
Maya Chen: ```json
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "redwood-1",
  "input": "run onboarding eval set A",
  "route": "customer-tenant-42"
}
```
Maya Chen: error seen: `429 rate_limit_exceeded` from /v1/generate when they batch 200 short requests in 60s. Also noted occasional diffs when we rolled from redwood-1.0 -> redwood-1.1 where outputs changed unexpectedly.
Priya Sinha: thanks — what's the actual customer impact? Is it blocking their evals or flaky results hurting validation?
Maya Chen: both. They said the rate-limiting causes false negatives in their onboarding acceptance tests — they re-run which costs them time, and the model variant mismatch caused a couple of hallucinations in their demo flows. They called the pinning issue "high friction" for their legal review.
Luca Marino: I can repro the rate-limit in our staging if you share the tenant id and example payloads. I assume they're hitting Dedicated through the routing policy.
Amir Patel: renewal is in 22 days. Customer success wants this triaged ASAP. I'd label as "renewal-risk". :warning:
Priya Sinha: proposed triage: 1) confirm whether we can support endpoint-level model pinning (product story), 2) short-term mitigation: increase per-tenant burst quota or provide a recommended batching pattern and sample script (devex), 3) long-term: add onboarding health dashboard to show eval success rates. Thoughts?
Eliot Ramirez: agree. For quick wins, devex can provide a sample client that does async batching to avoid the 429s. Luca, can you estimate time to repro and share a minimal repro script?
Luca Marino: will try today. If it's just quota config we can patch a Dedicated policy. If it's a routing issue causing variant mismatch, might take longer.
Maya Chen: customer asked for two deliverables before renewal: (A) a reproducible mitigation for the 429s they can test within 5 days, (B) a product commitment on model pinning timeline.
Priya Sinha: I'll carve out two tickets: PROD-XXXX - "Endpoint-level model pinning: investigation + spec" and UX-YYYY - "Onboarding health dashboard: wireframes + metrics". If someone can create the GH issues, add labels `cs-request`, `renewal-risk`, and assign to me for prioritization.
Maya Chen: creating GH now and will paste links.
prod-bot: Created issue #4862 in redwood/product: "Endpoint-level model pinning — investigation" (link: https://gh.company/4862)
Maya Chen: https://gh.company/4862 (assigned to @Priya), https://gh.company/4863 (onboarding dashboard, assigned to @Priya).
Amir Patel: tagging execs in the renewal tracker and noting the mitigation path. If we can deliver the mitigation script + quota tweak, customer will likely proceed.
Eliot Ramirez: Luca, once you have repro, please attach the logs and a minimal test harness. I'll put this on the next product sync agenda. :+1:
Luca Marino: will do, ETA EOD.
Maya Chen: thanks all — I'll update the customer tonight with the plan: reproduce -> short mitigation -> timeline for pinning spec.
Priya Sinha: sounds good. Prioritizing as P1 for the mitigation and P2 for the product spec (but we can escalate if execs request).
Maya Chen: noted. I'll ping again after Luca confirms repro. :thumbsup:
